WITH hand_tallies AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(p.throws, 'missing') AS throwing_hand,
           COUNT(*) AS tally
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws, 'missing')
),
shares AS (
    SELECT throwing_hand,
           tally,
           CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_tallies
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.tally) AS combined_tally,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
